book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIKHEHNAH

content: Apostol cangnah
Zalongpaw cang bei neh maw? Apostol cang bei neh maw? Kaa Buipaw Zisu a hmuhpaw cang bei neh maw? Naaning sahlo heh Abuipaw a rai ka hrepaw letei a thuisu cawh cang bei he ceh maw?
Ming hringpaw khatah apostol ka cang ly zong tahmai naaning khaco ka cang hrahring kho! Zecawtamaw tatah Abuipaw letei apostol ka cangnahpaw cakhai cawh naaning sahlo heh na cang he ceh hi.
Ka kong a pacepaw sahlo letei ka reicakainahpaw cawh ma heh a cang.
Khrisawbu taitah ding le e hmuhnah naw hnui bei peh maw?
Ahringpaw apostol sahlo le Abuipaw a uny sahlo le, Piter tei a chuilai pawhe hratah zingtu nupui a chuilainah naw hnui hrah bei he peh maw?
A cang ly leh Barnaba le kama suipaw heh maw kaa hringnah cawtah rai a hrepai ruapaw cawh ka cang peh?
Ama a hnuichia hmang tah ahohmai raekeh rai hre bang bei he. Misur lui tua ka, misur thui e lytah ahohmai ung bang bei he. Tuurung king ka, a hnabaetui ding lytah ahohmai ung bang bei he.
Cawngsaw phung longtei tah ma heh rei bei neh. Phungbia tah ma hraco a tah hrah.
Zecawtamaw tatah Moses phungbia letah ma hrahei a cia hi, “Co tungpaw cawh sacaang a ci chung taco, a hmo tongchai khe o,” tatah Khazing tei a rei dupaw cawh co tungpaw cawh maw a cang?

Ma heh kaaning kaa cawtah a reipaw a cang hi, cang thlang bei maw? A cang, ma heh kaaning kaa cawtah za ciapaw a cang, zecawtamaw tatah alui a thawngpaw tah a thawng tihtah le saze a cipaw tah a ci tihtah kaa tingvy a ung hrah tatah hnabeisuinah khatah aa tuapaw a cang.
Kaaning cawh naa hrong letah Thlawpaw thleci va peh ka, naaning taitah aluicung hming a thuisu kaa hre tihtah ma cawh a hlu tu maw?

Ming hringpaw tahmai naaning taitah pehlainah hmuhnah naw aa hnui caco, kaaning cawh ka hmuh chichi ruapaw cang bei maw? Canghrasala, kaaning cawh ma naw hnuinah cawh hmang bei peh. Khri thawngchawbia heh a pakhang a paduipaw a ung ly nápawtah zezong lungsy tah kaa ing hri.

Behnah ing letei rai a hrepaw sahlo tah aa e ruapaw cawh behnah ing taitah hmuh he ka, dangnah siasang letei raihretu sahlo takhei dangnah siasang letei aa hlaipaw lekhei tingvy aa hnui hrah takhah naa hni.
Ma hraco thawngchawbia a reipaw sahlo taco thawngchawbia reinah thongtah aa pori congnah aa hmuh ruapaw a cang tah heh Abuipaw biapeh a cang hi.

Canghrasala, kama cawh ma nawhnuinah sahlo heh sangkheh hmai hmang bang bei neh. Taico, ma hapaw hming cawh pa tuapah na he seh tah rawhchainá tah ma ca heh ka va ciapaw zong cang be. Ma ka pachawnah lehei pakheh kheh tah a pa pahnong a pa pakha navy co, thih hmai tah ka du vy hri hi.
Thawngchawbia ka reilaipaw rawng tahei co a pachaw khy bei neh, zecawtamaw tatah rei law tatah hranghrang tah siapaw ka cang. Thawngchawbia ka rei ly caco, ka cing a ping hi!
Ma lungthó tah ka rei caco, longmai ka hmuh a. Ma taco cang lytah Khazing tei a pa khingpaw rai khah ka hrepaw a cang.
Mataico zemaw ka longmai cawh a cang? Thawngchawbia reinah lehei amai lytah ching he neh ka, ma thawngchawbia reinah lehei ka nawhnuinah ka hmang lypaw heh a cang.
Kama cawh zalongpaw cang neh ka, aho a sae hmai ka cang ly naná teitah cawngsaw a hlu vy maw ka tle khy bo he tah neh ka, ming maikaw aa sae tah ka tua lai.

Juda cawngsaw sahlo tle rua pawtah Juda cawngsaw sahlo khatah ka ungning taco, Juda cawngsaw hratah ka tua. Kama cawh phungbia rai letah a ungpaw ka cang ly naná teitah phungbia rai letei a ungpaw sahlo khatah ka ungning taco, phungbia rai letei a ungpaw sahlo hratah ka tua. Phungbia rai letei a ungpaw sahlo tle rua pawtah ma hrahei ka tua.

A hmuisui teico, Khazing phungbia taitah lua bei neh. Khri phungbia rai letah ka ung thlang naná teitah phungbia a hnui lypaw sahlo khatah ka ungning taco, phungbia a hnui lypaw hratah ka tua. Ma cawh phungbia a hnui lypaw sahlo he tle rua pawtah a cang.

A thaw a padiapaw sahlo tle rua pawtah a thaw a padiapaw sahlo khatah ka ungning taco, a thaw a padiapaw hratah ka tua. A cawngpe chang maw sangkheh khé hei ka pachah khy bo he, ka tah cawtah ming maikaw khatah aaning hratah ka tua lai hrah.
Ma ka tuapaw heh thawngchawbia cawtah cang ka, ma pawsui co a bonghnang ka hrong khy a.
A saipasinah letah a zawngpaw vytei cawh sai he ka, canghrasala pakheh long tah longmai a hmuh tah cawh hnih thlang bei he ceh maw? Ma hraco longmai hmuh a pawtah sai hrah my lo.

A tuapasinah letei a zawngpaw maikaw taco cawngnah khah hmuisui teitah aa tua tei. Ma cawh a hming lypaw longmai hmuh ruapaw cawtah a cang, canghrasala kaaning tei kaa tuapaw cawh chaizaw a hmingpaw longmai hmuh rua pawtah a cang hi.
Macawtaco kama cawh tingchipaw a hnui lypaw cawngsaw a saipaw hratah sai bei neh, ka thong tihtah a longpaw a thongpaw cawngsaw hratah a thong bei neh.
Ming hringpaw a cawngpah pawhe cang tlung neh ka, kama tamaw longmai hmuh a tlah lypaw cang kaw leneh tatah ka pung cawh hreh neh ka, achaw teitah ka hraipaking.
